templateId.description: Accessible workspace template, existing gamma or official Explore template ID; source remains unchanged.

sharingOptions.description: Requested permissions and email sharing; administrator restrictions may cause warnings instead of application.

emailOptions.description: Email sharing configuration; may cause invitations to be sent.

access.description: Recipient permission; omitted uses provider default.

items.description: Recipient email address.

recipients.description: Email addresses to share the new gamma with.

externalAccess.description: Permission via external shared links; omitted leaves provider defaults.

workspaceAccess.description: Default permission for workspace members; omitted leaves provider defaults.

disableConnectors.description: True opts this run out of workspace connector access; omission uses provider behavior.

additionalInstructions.description: Additional tone, audience, language or style guidance; empty string adds no guidance.

FunctionInput_gamma_createagentgeneratio.description: Brief and optional generation, source, placement and sharing settings for a new Gamma 5 job.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of ignored settings or other qualifications.

generationId.description: Opaque generation job ID for get-generation.

FunctionOutput_gamma_createagentgenerati.description: Accepted agent generation job handle and request-level warnings, not a generated artifact.

tags.instructions: Use for new presentations, documents and social posts. Use `create-classic-generation` for webpages or multiple pages, or `create-template-generation` to preserve an eligible workspace template's structure by default. Obtain optional folder IDs from `list-folders`. Save the returned warnings and check progress with `get-generation` using engine `agent`; creation does not mean the gamma is ready. Generation spends credits and repeated calls create new jobs.

folderId.description: Destination folder; omission uses workspace root/provider placement.

numCards.description: Single-page target card count, subject to plan limits.

tags.instructions: Use for webpages, multi-page gammas/sites, or Classic text-preservation and layout controls. Prefer `create-agent-generation` for agent-led presentations. Provide either inputText or pages, not both. Multiple pages create one gamma, not a batch of independent gammas. Obtain folder IDs with `list-folders`. Check the result with `get-generation` using engine classic. Generation spends credits; publish can make a site available, and sharing may send invitations.

functions.name: create-gamma-export
functions.description: Start an asynchronous PDF, PPTX or PNG-ZIP export of a viewable, non-archived gamma in the connected workspace.

tags.instructions: Use `get-gamma` or `search-gammas` to obtain a target ID. This starts an export and returns a job ID, not a finished download. Use `get-gamma-export` to check completion. PNG exports contain one image per card in a ZIP. Use a creation tool's exportAs option if you want export as part of new generation instead.

functions.name: get-gamma-edit
functions.description: Read one edit job's current state, target page, applied-change summary, failure details and available credit accounting.

editId.description: Opaque job ID returned by edit-gamma.

FunctionInput_gamma_getgammaedit.description: The edit job whose current state should be read.

error.description: Terminal edit failure; inspect for partial changes before retrying.

statusCode.description: Indicative HTTP-style failure status, not polling response status.

pageId.description: Specific page targeted by this edit.

status.description: Current edit state; failed can include partially applied changes.

credits.description: Terminal accounting; absent members mean unknown, not zero.

deducted.description: Best-effort credits recorded as debited so far; may grow after completion, and zero means no recorded charge.

remaining.description: Current user balance in this workspace at this check, not job cost.

gammaId.description: Canonical file ID of the edited gamma.

gammaUrl.description: URL at which to inspect the gamma.

updatedAt.description: Last job state change as a UTC instant.

FunctionOutput_gamma_getgammaedit.description: Current edit state, target, available result or failure, and credit accounting.

tags.instructions: Use the editId from `update-gamma`. Each call checks once. If pending, check again after about five seconds. Stop on completed or failed. A failed edit can have partially changed the gamma: inspect its URL before issuing another edit. Use `get-gamma` for metadata, not edit state.

functions.name: get-gamma-export
functions.description: Get one export job's state, canonical gamma ID, format, download URL or rendering failure.

FunctionInput_gamma_getgammaexport.description: Identify the export job to check once.

reason.description: Optional machine-readable failure: transient render_timeout/export_failed or input-changing deck_too_large/no_content.

statusCode.description: Indicative error status, not the successful status lookup response.

gammaId.description: Canonical parent file ID, even when export was requested with a page/doc ID.

exportAs.description: Original requested format, available in all job states; PNG is a ZIP artifact.

exportUrl.description: Secret bearer download link when completed; approximately one-week lifetime, no key needed.

FunctionOutput_gamma_getgammaexport.description: Current export state, canonical gamma, requested format, and available download or failure details.

tags.instructions: Use exportId from `create-gamma-export`. This checks once; while pending, wait about five seconds before checking again. Completed PNG exports are ZIP archives, not single PNGs. Treat exportUrl as a secret: anyone holding it can download until it expires, about one week. For render_timeout/export_failed, start a new export later; deck_too_large/no_content requires changing the gamma.

functions.name: get-generation
functions.description: Get the current state, available artifacts, warnings and credit accounting for one agent or Classic generation job.

error.description: Failure details returned as job data, not a failed status-check invocation.

reason.description: Provider machine-readable reason when present; agent reasons include access_revoked, generation_failed, insufficient_credits, timeout and unavailable.

message.description: Human-readable failure details; inspect any partially created gamma before restarting.

statusCode.description: Provider indicative HTTP-style status, not the successful polling request's status.

pages.description: Classic multi-page results only; preserves provider order and individual page states.

error.description: This page's failure details, when supplied.

reason.description: Provider machine-readable reason when present; agent reasons include access_revoked, generation_failed, insufficient_credits, timeout and unavailable.

message.description: Human-readable failure details; inspect any partially created gamma before restarting.

statusCode.description: Provider indicative HTTP-style status, not the successful polling request's status.

pageId.description: Doc/page ID, not the containing file ID.

status.description: This page's state, which may differ from other pages.

gammaUrl.description: Direct URL of this generated page.

exportUrl.description: Secret per-page export URL, when available.

items.description: One Classic generated page and its individual state.

status.description: Current job state; only completed establishes generation completion.

credits.description: Reported accounting; absent or absent members mean unknown, never zero by default.

deducted.description: Classic credits consumed; for agent jobs, best-effort credits recorded as debited so far, which can increase after completion. Zero means no charge recorded, not necessarily no cost.

gammaId.description: Generated file ID; optional before completion or when failure prevented file creation.

summary.description: Agent-written generation summary; present on completed agent jobs.

tags.instructions: Use the generationId and engine returned by a generation-creation tool. This performs one status check, not a wait for completion. While pending, check again after about five seconds. Only completed means generation is done, even if a gamma URL or progress is already present. Keep create-time warnings. Treat export URLs as secrets; PNG exports are ZIP archives. Use `get-gamma` for metadata rather than job state.

functions.name: update-gamma
functions.description: Start an asynchronous AI edit of one page of an existing gamma. Requires edit permission and can change existing content; it cannot add pages.

prompt.description: Natural-language instruction describing the intended changes to existing content.

gammaId.description: Gamma file ID for its main page, or doc/page ID for that specific page.

quality.description: Model effort tier; omitted uses the plan-capped API default.

disableConnectors.description: True prevents this edit from using workspace connectors; omitted uses provider behavior.

FunctionInput_gamma_updategamma.description: Target gamma and natural-language edit instruction, with optional quality and connector controls.

editId.description: Edit job ID to pass to get-gamma-edit.

gammaUrl.description: URL of the gamma being edited; not proof of completion.

FunctionOutput_gamma_updategamma.description: Asynchronous edit job handle and the URL of the gamma being edited.

tags.instructions: Use `get-gamma` or `search-gammas` to obtain the target. A file ID edits its main page; a page ID edits that page. Describe the desired changes, not a replacement metadata object. Check completion with `get-gamma-edit`. Only one edit runs per page. Failed edits may be partially applied: inspect the gamma before retrying. This changes content and spends credits; replay is not safe.
